title: nephrodium filix-mas subsp. patentissimum
intro: Nephrodium filix-mas subsp. patentissimum, commonly known as Lady Fern, is a subspecies of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is valued for its traditional use in herbal medicine, where it is said to offer several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Lady Fern include expectorant, anti-tussive, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to ease respiratory issues and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of Lady Fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential role in preventing chronic diseases such as cancer and neurodegenerative disorders.
